snippet.title: HYPERWIRED - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
A Gameplay Trailer for HYPERWIRED. HYPERWIRED is a classic top-down action shooter, where your spaceship has a plug hanging from it! Upgrade your abilities using your plug, solve puzzles and explore. HYPERWIRED is coming to PC in 2026

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3234850/HYPERWIRED/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow
